statement: Between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-24, US Central Command or the Iranian IRGC publicly announces at least one new attack on a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman.
resolution: TRUE if a CENTCOM release or IRGC statement dated inside the window describes striking or attacking a vessel in that waterway, carried by two of Al Jazeera, BBC, Reuters, AP.
failure_condition: No CENTCOM or IRGC announcement of a vessel attack in that waterway bears a date inside the window.

statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged at 3.50 to 3.75 percent at its scheduled September 15-16, 2026 meeting. Reference: target range 3.50 to 3.75 percent at seal.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC policy statement published 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov keeps the target range at 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
failure_condition: The September 16 statement sets any target range other than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures post a settlement at or above 110.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-09. Reference: Brent 101.13 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE published settlement price for the front-month Brent contract reaches 110.00 or higher on any trading day inside the window.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement inside the window prints below 110.00 USD per barrel.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one Google Chrome or Chromium CVE with a date-added value between 2026-09-09 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: TRUE if the KEV JSON feed on cisa.gov carries an entry with vendorProject Google and a dateAdded value inside that range.
failure_condition: No Google or Chromium entry in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one SAP CVE with a date-added value between 2026-09-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the KEV JSON feed on cisa.gov carries an entry with vendorProject SAP and a dateAdded value inside that range.
failure_condition: No SAP entry in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-09 and 2026-10-16, the UK government announces the closure or suspension of operations at its Consulate General in Jerusalem.
resolution: TRUE if an FCDO statement, a gov.uk notice, or a ministerial statement in Hansard dated inside the window announces closure or suspension of that post.
failure_condition: The UK Consulate General in Jerusalem remains in operation with no announced closure or suspension.

statement: A Federal Register document from the Census Bureau or the Department of Commerce proposing 2030 Census content on citizenship or on race and ethnicity categories publishes between 2026-09-10 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: TRUE if federalregister.gov returns at least one document from that agency, on that subject, with a publication date inside the window.
failure_condition: No such Federal Register document carries a publication date inside the window.

statement: USGS records at least one earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater anywhere on Earth with an origin time between 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query for minmagnitude 7.0 over that origin-time range returns at least one event.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog returns zero events at magnitude 7.0 or above for that origin-time range.

statement: Between 2026-09-10 and 2026-11-30, the Nigerian federal government or its armed forces publicly confirm a ceasefire arrangement with Boko Haram.
resolution: TRUE if a named Nigerian government or military spokesperson confirms such an arrangement on the record, reported by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, Al Jazeera.
failure_condition: No on-the-record Nigerian government or military confirmation of a Boko Haram ceasefire occurs inside the window.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity rate closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 4.85 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 records a value of 5.00 or higher on any business day inside the window.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation inside the window prints below 5.00 percent.
